b.lede: Fugaku, Japan's most powerful supercomputer, has suffered a suspected data breach, with the information of more than 4,000 of its users potentially stolen as a result.
b.title: Japan’s most powerful supercomputer may have been hacked, over 4,000 users’ personal data stolen
